Patched the existing `officeqa-bond-yield-spread-monthly` skill with the new sub-variant.

What was generalizable here: this question reused the same yield-spread argmin machinery already documented, but added a twist not previously captured — instead of encoding the extremum date as a number (`month*100+year`), it used the extremum month/year as an index to look up an unrelated line item ("railroad retirement account trust receipts") in a completely separate trust-fund table, returned in full nominal dollars. The key reusable facts:

- Two lookups in two different table sections of the same bulletin (yield table for the argmin, trust-receipts table for the answer).
- The min spread lands at the opposite end of the decade from the max (early-1960s narrowest gap).
- Scaling a "millions" column back to full dollars (92 → 92000000).

No memory update needed — this is procedural and belongs in the skill, not in cross-session memory. The skill patch is the right home. Done.
